description: Source code for the Android AudioTrack class, managing audio playback, buffers, and thread processing within the Android media framework.

classes.name: AudioTrack
classes.description: Main class managing audio playback, buffers, and thread control within Android's media framework.

classes.name: AudioTrack::AudioTrackThread
classes.description: Thread class responsible for processing audio buffers in a dedicated thread.

classes.name: audio_track_cblk_t
classes.description: Control block structure managing buffer indices, flags, and synchronization for audio buffers.

classes.name: TimedAudioTrack
classes.description: Derived class for timed audio playback, managing timed buffers and synchronization.

methods.name: getMinFrameCount
methods.description: Calculates minimum frame count based on stream type and sample rate, considering hardware latency.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Initializes or reconfigures the AudioTrack with specified parameters.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Returns the current initialization status of the AudioTrack.

methods.name: latency
methods.description: Returns the latency of the audio output.

methods.name: streamType
methods.description: Returns the stream type associated with the AudioTrack.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the audio format used by the track.

methods.name: channelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

methods.name: frameCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames in the buffer.

methods.name: frameSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a single audio frame.

methods.name: sharedBuffer
methods.description: Returns the shared memory buffer if used.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts audio playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops audio playback.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Checks if the track is stopped.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the buffer and resets playback position.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses audio playback.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the track.

methods.name: muted
methods.description: Returns whether the track is muted.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the left and right volume levels.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves current volume levels.

methods.name: setAuxEffectSendLevel
methods.description: Sets the auxiliary effect send level.

methods.name: getAuxEffectSendLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the auxiliary effect send level.

methods.name: setSampleRate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for playback.

methods.name: getSampleRate
methods.description: Gets the current sample rate.

methods.name: setLoop
methods.description: Sets loop points and count.

methods.name: setMarkerPosition
methods.description: Sets a marker position for callbacks.

methods.name: getMarkerPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the marker position.

methods.name: setPositionUpdatePeriod
methods.description: Sets the period for position update callbacks.

methods.name: getPositionUpdatePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the position update period.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the current playback position.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Gets the current playback position.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the buffer, resetting the write index.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the audio output handle.

methods.name: attachAuxEffect
methods.description: Attaches an auxiliary effect to the track.

methods.name: createTrack_l
methods.description: Creates and initializes the underlying audio track with specified parameters.

methods.name: obtainBuffer
methods.description: Obtains a buffer for writing audio data.

methods.description: Releases a buffer after writing.

methods.description: Main processing loop for audio buffer handling in the dedicated thread.
